title: cost_params
description: Walking cost parameters (C4). Fields one to one with MartianMap.Routing.CostParams.

v0_mps.description: Flat-ground walking speed at 0.38 g, m/s.

b.description: Tobler exponent; sensitivity range low..high (NOT VERIFIED at reduced gravity).

c.description: Tobler grade offset; 0 is the symmetric function.

max_slope_deg.description: Nodes with slope above this are blocked.

relief_block_cm.description: Nodes with local relief above this are blocked.

relief_penalty_from_cm.description: f_rug drops below 1 from this relief on.

hazard_red_min.description: Hazard at or above this is red: blocked.

hazard_amber_min.description: Hazard at or above this and below red is amber.

f_rug_min.description: Floor of f_rug, reached at relief_block_cm.

amber_penalty_s_per_m.description: Seconds per metre walked in amber cells; route choice only, never in eta_s.

alt_safest_amber_mult.description: Amber penalty multiplier of the safest alternative.

alt_gentlest_s_per_m.description: Seconds per metre of height change added by the gentlest alternative.
